Attack when the blade glows with a golden light to unleash an electrical attack.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 22 |durability = 50 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Thunderspear}} Thunderspears are magical [[Weapon]]s that can be found on [[Hyrule Ridge]] and in [[Hyrule Field]], particularly within [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. Their spearheads contain thunder from the [[Thundra Plateau]] in their tips. This elemental nature makes them a part of the [[Magic Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} When their blades glow, they are able to unleash an attack that will electrocute [[Enemy|Enemies]]. Being made of metal, Thunderspears attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They also sink in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but can be manipulated and picked back up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. When exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], Thunderspears do not burn like wooden Weapons do. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_035" |Life = 50 |Power = 22 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 5000 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 1000 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 50.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 23 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 150 |BuyingPrice = 450 }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Great Thunderblade * Magic Gear * Thunderblade * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Magic Gear, Spears, Weapons |items= BotW }}
